compliance_or_approvals.description: List any approval gates, sign-offs, or compliance checks mentioned. Format: 'check — who approves'. Return null if none.
compliance_or_approvals.name: compliance_or_approvals

dependencies.description: People, teams, or external parties the contributor depends on
dependencies.name: dependencies

edge_cases.description: Edge cases, exceptions, or "when things go wrong" scenarios described
edge_cases.name: edge_cases

process_steps.description:
Extract the process steps described by the contributor as a JSON array.
Each step is an object with these fields:
- id: short kebab-case identifier (e.g. 'pull-workday-data')
- name: step name as described
- type: one of 'action', 'decision', 'handoff', 'wait'
  - 'action': a task someone performs
  - 'decision': a point where the process branches based on a condition
  - 'handoff': where responsibility transfers to another person or team
  - 'wait': where the process blocks on an external dependency
- actor: who performs this step (name or role)
- tools: array of tools/systems used at this step (empty array if none)
- duration: estimated time if mentioned, or null

Example output:
[
  {\"id\": \"pull-data\", \"name\": \"Pull employee data from Workday\", \"type\": \"action\", \"actor\": \"Payroll Analyst\", \"tools\": [\"Workday HRIS\"], \"duration\": \"2 hours\"},
  {\"id\": \"validate-bands\", \"name\": \"Validate against compensation bands\", \"type\": \"action\", \"actor\": \"Payroll Analyst\", \"tools\": [\"Excel\", \"Internal Wiki\"], \"duration\": \"1 day\"},
  {\"id\": \"check-exceptions\", \"name\": \"Check for terminated employees\", \"type\": \"decision\", \"actor\": \"Payroll Analyst\", \"tools\": [], \"duration\": null},
  {\"id\": \"escalate-hr\", \"name\": \"Send to HR for confirmation\", \"type\": \"handoff\", \"actor\": \"Payroll Analyst\", \"tools\": [\"Email\"], \"duration\": null},
  {\"id\": \"wait-hr\", \"name\": \"Wait for HR response\", \"type\": \"wait\", \"actor\": \"HR team\", \"tools\": [], \"duration\": \"1-2 days\"}
]

Return valid JSON only. If no clear steps were described, return an empty array [].
process_steps.name: process_steps

step_connections.description:
Extract how the process steps connect to each other as a JSON array.
Each connection is an object with:
- from: the id of the source step (matching an id from process_steps)
- to: the id of the target step
- condition: if this is a conditional branch, the condition text (e.g. 'If exceptions found'). null for normal sequential flow.

Example output:
[
  {\"from\": \"pull-data\", \"to\": \"validate-bands\", \"condition\": null},
  {\"from\": \"validate-bands\", \"to\": \"check-exceptions\", \"condition\": null},
  {\"from\": \"check-exceptions\", \"to\": \"escalate-hr\", \"condition\": \"Exceptions found\"},
  {\"from\": \"check-exceptions\", \"to\": \"calculate-amounts\", \"condition\": \"No exceptions\"},
  {\"from\": \"escalate-hr\", \"to\": \"wait-hr\", \"condition\": null}
]

Return valid JSON only. If steps are purely sequential with no branches, still include each connection. Return empty array [] if connections cannot be determined.
step_connections.name: step_connections

step_issues.description:
For each step where the contributor expressed a problem, delay, frustration, or workaround, extract a JSON array of issue objects.
Each issue has:
- step_id: matching an id from process_steps
- pain_point: the specific frustration or problem described, or null
- is_bottleneck: true if the contributor described this step as slow, delayed, blocking, or error-prone
- bottleneck_reason: why it's a bottleneck, or null
- workaround: any unofficial shortcut or trick the contributor uses at this step, or null

Example output:
[
  {\"step_id\": \"validate-bands\", \"pain_point\": \"Manually checking 400 rows every month\", \"is_bottleneck\": true, \"bottleneck_reason\": \"Takes a full day of manual work\", \"workaround\": null},
  {\"step_id\": \"wait-hr\", \"pain_point\": \"HR slow to respond near quarter-end\", \"is_bottleneck\": true, \"bottleneck_reason\": \"1-2 day block on external team\", \"workaround\": \"Sometimes calls HR directly instead of emailing\"}
]

Return valid JSON only. Return empty array [] if no issues were raised.
step_issues.name: step_issues

total_process_duration.description: If the contributor mentioned how long the entire process takes end-to-end, extract that estimate. Examples: 'about a week', '5-7 business days'. Return null if not mentioned.
total_process_duration.name: total_process_duration

volume.description: Roughly how many times, cases or items the process handles, per run or per period (e.g. '40 requests a month', 'every employee, about 3,000, once a year'). Null if not mentioned.
volume.name: volume
